description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5945016919610 RELAY,SOLID STATE: Line 0001 Qty 121 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0068 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
